_comment: Ratchet only: raise a value when a fix lands (the report lists what to raise it to); never lower one to get green. Coverage is authoritative / (authoritative + gated). maxCheckerErrors (default 0) only goes down: the known failed Krit actions are //data and //proto (#1688). findings-parity.gradleOnly lists the path prefixes with no Bazel target (#1752); their findings are left out of the comparison.
